name: manual double-click TX authority and direct-caller preemption

incident.root_cause: native direct-reply lock treated the unanswered REPLYING/Tx1 state as a progressed QSO

policy.manual_double_click: always arm Enable Tx after a successfully processed decode
policy.quick_call_preference: does not weaken explicit double-click authority
policy.unanswered_tx1: may be preempted by a station addressing OM0RX
policy.progressed_qso: protected once report stage or equivalent report/73 evidence exists
policy.direct_caller_filters: direct callers retain their existing filter exemption

verification.safe_cutover: Halt Tx acknowledged before process replacement
